import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    hist = inputs["dim_emp_hist"]
    queries = inputs["asof_queries"]

    merged = queries.merge(hist, on="emp_id", how="inner", suffixes=("", "_h"))

    mask_start = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    mask_end = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    result = merged[mask_start & mask_end]

    result = result[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]]

    return {"asof_result": result.reset_index(drop=True)}
